title: Software Engineering Fundamentals (sample)
note: Sample questions. Replace them with your own: keep the same fields. 'answer' is the 0-based index of the correct option.

questions.text: Which of these Python data types is immutable?
What does len({1, 2, 2, 3}) return in Python?
Which SOLID principle says a class should have only one reason to change?
Which Git command creates a new branch and switches to it in one step?
What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n items?
Which SQL clause filters rows AFTER they have been grouped?
Which HTTP status code means the requested resource was not found?
Which data structure removes items in first-in, first-out (FIFO) order?
What does the acronym API stand for?
Which level of testing checks individual functions or classes in isolation?
What is the value of 7 // 2 in Python?
Which attack inserts malicious SQL through an input field to change a database query?
Which protocol encrypts web traffic between a browser and a server?
In Scrum, what is the name of the fixed-length period in which a team completes a set of work?
What is the main benefit of Python's `with` statement when working with files?
options: It makes the file read faster
It closes the file automatically, even if an error occurs
It copies the file to memory permanently
